definitions.explanation: The very best or most outstanding within a particular group or category. Always used with a preceding scope (e.g., 日本随一 — the best in Japan).

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{社内|しゃない}{随一|ずいいち}の{営業|えいぎょう}マンだ。
examples.english: He is the best salesperson in the company.

examples.japanese: ここは{日本|にほん}{随一|ずいいち}の{温泉地|おんせんち}だ。
examples.english: This is Japan's foremost hot spring resort area.

examples.japanese: {世界|せかい}{随一|ずいいち}の{技術力|ぎじゅつりょく}を{誇|ほこ}るメーカーに{成長|せいちょう}した。
examples.english: It has grown into a manufacturer that boasts the world's foremost technological capabilities.

notes:
Compound of {随|ずい} (follow/accompany) + {一|いち} (number one). Always preceded by a scope that specifies the group being compared.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {日本|にほん}{随一|ずいいち}の～ (Japan's foremost ~)
- {世界|せかい}{随一|ずいいち}の～ (the world's foremost ~)
- {社内|しゃない}{随一|ずいいち}の～ (the company's best ~)
- {業界|ぎょうかい}{随一|ずいいち}の～ (the industry's foremost ~)

USAGE NOTE:
A formal expression of superlative praise. More literary and elevated than {一番|いちばん}. Cannot be used without a preceding group or category — you cannot say just {随一|ずいいち} alone.
